subject.title: fix: reject unsafe Mattermost API path segments

question: Should this security-sensitive Mattermost fix wait for controlled HTTP transport proof, or should maintainers explicitly override the external-PR proof gate based on the mocked boundary coverage?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and prior code findings are resolved, but repository policy treats mocked tests as supplemental rather than real behavior proof for an external security-boundary PR.

options.title: Require controlled HTTP proof
options.body: Ask for redacted local-server output proving unsafe paths create no authenticated request and valid paths retain their expected request target.

options.title: Approve a proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the focused mocked boundary coverage as sufficient for this narrowly scoped fail-closed change.

recommendation.title: Require controlled HTTP proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted local-server output proving unsafe paths create no authenticated request and valid paths retain their expected request target.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned, authored the latest two boundary changes, and is best placed to provide or authorize the proof decision.
